Joplo 黄金案例：空间管理员邀请成员并指定协作权限。方案仅用于测试设计能力，: Joplo reference demo: a space admin invites members and sets their access. The options exist to exercise design capabilities, not to recommend a real product.
空间管理员邀请同事加入空间并指定权限，让新成员当天就能开始协作: Space admins invite teammates and set their access, so new members can start working the same day
受邀者不能获得高于设定的权限: Invitees never get more access than was set
在成员页点一个按钮，弹窗里填写一个邮箱和权限后发送邮件邀请: One button on the Members page opens a dialog: enter an email and a role, then send the invite
操作入口与步骤组织：就地弹窗、一次一人: Entry point and steps: an in-place dialog, one person at a time
路径最短，适合偶尔邀请一两个人: Shortest path; good for inviting one or two people now and then
一次只能邀请一人，批量邀请效率低: Only one person at a time; slow for inviting many
已是成员时提示错误还是静默跳过，尚未决定: Not decided yet: show an error or skip silently when the person is already a member
B · 独立页面批量邀请: B · Bulk invites on their own page
成员页进入独立的「批量邀请」页面，一次粘贴多个邮箱，提交后逐个显示结果: From Members, open a separate Bulk invite page, paste several emails at once, and see a result for each after sending
步骤组织：独立页面、批量处理，并展示部分失败: Steps: a separate page, bulk processing, and partial failures shown
适合一次邀请很多人: Good for inviting many people at once
多一次页面跳转，偶尔邀请一人时偏重: One extra page; heavy when you invite just one person
需要设计部分失败的结果展示: Needs a design for showing partial failures
部分失败已画出，整体请求失败尚未设计: Partial failure is drawn; a failed request overall is not designed yet
管理员发出邀请，受邀者接受后成为成员: The admin sends an invite; the invitee accepts and becomes a member
不能发起邀请，并看到原因: They can't start an invite and see why
阻止提交并就地提示: Sending is blocked with a message next to the field
邀请被撤销后再次打开链接: Opening the link after the invite was revoked
说明邀请已失效，并告诉对方去找空间管理员: Explains the invite no longer works and tells them to contact a space admin
说明邀请已过期，可以请管理员重新邀请: Explains the invite expired and that an admin can invite them again
被邀请人已经是成员: The invitee is already a member
明确失败，保留输入，可以重试: Clear failure, input kept, retry possible
只有空间管理员可以发起邀请: Only space admins can start an invite
受邀者获得的权限不能高于邀请时设定的权限: Invitees can't get more access than the role set in the invite
已发出的邀请可以撤销: Invites already sent can be revoked
发送失败后保留已填写的邮箱和权限，允许直接重试: After a failed send, the email and role stay filled in so you can retry right away
发送中禁用「发送邀请」按钮，防止重复提交: While sending, Send invite is disabled to prevent a double send
批量提交时逐个显示结果，失败项可单独重试，成功项不回滚: Bulk sends show a result for each email; failed ones can be retried alone and successful ones are not rolled back
被邀请人已经是成员时，应该报错还是静默跳过？: When the invitee is already a member, should it show an error or skip silently?
只有空间管理员可以邀请成员: Only space admins can invite members
入口：成员页右上角，只对管理员可用: Entry point: top right of the Members page, admins only
你是普通成员，邀请新成员需要联系空间管理员。: You are a member. To invite someone, contact a space admin.
邀请链接已失效: The invite link no longer works
5 秒内可以撤回，本版未建模撤回流程: Can be undone within 5 seconds; undo is not modeled in this version
被邀请人会收到一封邮件，接受后加入本空间。: Invitees get an email and join this space once they accept.
受邀者获得的权限不会高于这里选择的权限: The invitee never gets more access than the role chosen here
正在发送，防止重复提交: Sending; the button is locked to prevent a double send
zhao.lei@example.com 的邀请链接会立即失效。之后还可以重新邀: The invite link for zhao.lei@example.com stops working right away. You can invite them again later.
本页面只用于展示整体布局，暂未建模设置行为。: This page only shows the overall layout; settings are not modeled yet.
这个邀请已经失效: This invite is no longer valid
邀请人撤销了这个邀请。\n请联系空间管理员重新邀请你。:
The person who invited you revoked this invite.
Ask a space admin to invite you again.
3 个邀请中 2 个成功，1 个失败。失败项可以单独重试。: 2 of 3 invites were sent and 1 failed. You can retry the failed one on its own.
提交后在这里显示每个邮箱的结果: After you send, each email's result appears here
弹窗关闭，出现成功提示，新邀请进入待接受列表: The dialog closes, a success message appears, and the new invite joins the pending list
管理员点击右上角「邀请成员」，打开邀请弹窗: The admin clicks Invite member at the top right to open the dialog
点击「发送邀请」，按钮进入发送中状态: Clicking Send invite puts the button into its sending state
邀请已发出，等待对方接受: The invite is out, waiting to be accepted
发送成功：弹窗关闭，邀请进入待接受: Sent: the dialog closes and the invite moves to Pending
模拟失败后重试成功: Mock: fails, then the retry succeeds
邀请请求失败（模拟网络超时）: The invite request fails (mock network timeout)
网络超时。已保留你填写的内容，可以重试。: The network timed out. What you entered is kept, so you can retry.
发送失败：弹窗不关，保留已填内容: Send failed: the dialog stays open and keeps what was entered
撤销邀请后对方再打开链接: The invitee opens the link after it was revoked
管理员撤销邀请，赵磊再打开链接时看到已失效: The admin revokes the invite; when Zhao Lei opens the link, it says it no longer works
链接页说明邀请已失效，并告诉对方去找空间管理员: The link page explains the invite no longer works and tells them to contact a space admin
确认后邀请立即失效: Once confirmed, the invite stops working
赵磊打开了邮件里的邀请链接: Zhao Lei opens the invite link from the email
赵磊知道邀请已失效、该找谁: Zhao Lei knows the invite is gone and whom to ask
链接页说明已失效和下一步: The link page explains it expired and what to do next
「邀请成员」按钮禁用，点击时说明只有管理员可以邀请: Invite member is disabled; clicking it explains that only admins can invite
模拟普通成员身份: Mock: signed in as a member
点击「批量邀请」进入独立页面: Click Bulk invite to open its page
输入三个邮箱（含一个错的）: Enter three emails, one of them invalid
部分完成：失败项可以单独重试: Partly done: retry the failed one on its own
2 个成功、1 个失败，逐个显示结果: 2 succeeded and 1 failed, with a result for each
取消并关闭；再次打开时是否保留已填内容待决定: Cancel and close; whether to keep what was entered when it reopens is still open
